pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: You asked to join this organisation. A manager has to approve it before you can see your team's data — until then, those pages will be empty.

approved.title: You're in
approved.body: Your membership was approved. Sign out and back in if your pages still look empty — your access is refreshed when you next sign in.

form.label: Which organisation are you with?
form.help: Your manager will confirm this before it takes effect.
form.notePlaceholder: Anything that helps them recognise you — your team, your start date (optional)
